reviews.author: Sounara2017scarscar

reviews.title: Good concept poor execution
reviews.text: I paid for the “premium” photo options and the “premium” settings. First the app is incredibly slow. Also they have advertisements between each photo I upload. (I already paid for two premium options and still get ads...which I have to pay to remove.) third, they don’t give an option to add side and back options. Fourth, you can’t reconfigure the dates so your front picture is the cover for each date. The app seems to choose the cover for each date randomly. Fifth, soooo much purple. I wasted two dollars on this app. Not again.
